infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AUTOSECURE uses the camera to scan the tracker/dashcam pairing code and to capture dashcam snapshots.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AUTOSECURE shows your vehicle's live location and the map alongside dashcam video.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: AUTOSECURE saves dashcam snapshots and vehicle documents you choose to keep.
